name: Time zone table
summary: A round table with each friend's clock and face, awake or asleep at their local hour; drag the hour hand and every clock turns until nobody is asleep, then send the invite.
useWhen: friends spread across time zones saying 'we should call'
winter or summer break, finding one hour that works in Seoul, Denver and New Jersey at once
dontUseWhen: everyone is in the same time zone (use meeting-time)
picking a day weeks out (use clear-skies)
an in-person plan (use a poll or an event)

params.title: string
params.people: up to 8 x {name, city, offset (hours from home zone), wake (0-23), sleep (up to 30 for past midnight), said}
